title: Uniform stability of recovering the Sturm-Liouville operator on a star-graph
summary: In the paper, we study the problem of recovering the Sturm-Liouville operator on a star-graph from the Weyl vector. It generalizes the problem of recovering the classical Sturm-Liouville operator on an interval from the Weyl function, and the problems of recovering from other spectral data can be reduced to this problem. The uniqueness and the constructive method for solving the problem under study were previously obtained by V.A. Yurko in the case of a tree (Inverse Problems, 2005).
